notes: Add items from a screenshot of another shopping app -- screenshot your cart or order in Meijer, Instacart, Walmart, whatever you use, and Stashpot reads the products off it. Pick up to 5 screenshots so a list longer than one screen works; overlapping scroll positions are recognised as the same list rather than counted twice. Nothing is saved until you review it: uncheck, edit or re-route any row, with a Shopping/Pantry switch for the whole list and a per-row override. Set the store for the list or per item. Rows worth checking are flagged and start unchecked -- already in your pantry, quantity cut off by the screenshot edge, or read twice. Frozen goes to the freezer and dairy/meat to the fridge. One Undo reverses the whole import.
